summary: The agent successfully implements a cross-validated pipeline using LightGBM and CatBoost but fails to calculate or report any validation metric to assess performance. Furthermore, it relies on a naive equal-weight ensemble, omits explicit missing value handling for numeric columns, performs no feature engineering, and introduces minor data leakage by using the combined train/test set for automated type inference.
